---
title: "MMR Vaccination and Measles Case Summary Figures"
output: html_document
params:
  schools: NULL
  facilities: NULL
  districts: NULL
  cases: NULL
  counties: NULL
  table_type: NULL
  boundary_type: NULL
  county: NULL
  district: NULL
  gt_sort_by: NULL
  notes: NULL
  coverage_bands: NULL
  case_age_groups: NULL
  settings: NULL
  features: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
features <- if (is.null(params$features)) all_features() else params$features
bands <- coverage_bands(params$coverage_bands)
notes <- if (is.null(params$notes)) default_settings()$notes else params$notes
historical <- isTRUE(params$table_type == "Historical Measles Cases")
childcare <- isTRUE(params$table_type == "Child Care Vaccine Coverage")
boundary <- if (isTRUE(params$boundary_type == "district")) "district" else "county"
```

```{r, fig.height=350/96, fig.width=850/96}
if (historical && features$epicurve) {
  plot_epicurve(params$cases, params$county, settings = params$settings,
    counties = case_county_universe(params$counties))
}
```

```{r}
if (historical && features$cases_summary) {
  render_cases_gt(params$cases, params$county,
    settings = params$settings, counties = case_county_universe(params$counties))
} else if (!historical && ((childcare && features$childcare_summary) ||
                           (!childcare && features$school_summary))) {
  build_coverage_table(params$schools, params$facilities, params$districts,
    table_type = if (childcare) "childcare" else "school", boundary_type = boundary,
    selected_county = params$county, selected_district = params$district,
    sort_by = params$gt_sort_by, notes = notes, bands = bands)
}
```
